literal_meaning: যমের যন্ত্রণা বা যাতনা (মৃত্যুদেব যমের কষ্টদায়ক অবস্থা)
figurative_meaning_en: Extreme suffering similar to the agony at the time of death
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবন যমযন্ত্রণার মতো হয়ে গেছে।
এই রোগ তার যমযাতনা সৃষ্টি করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His life has become like the agony of Yama.
This illness has caused him torment like the pangs of death.
history: References the Hindu god Yama, the deity of death, from ancient mythological texts like the Puranas.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Yama is depicted as the judge of the dead, symbolizing inevitable and severe suffering.
